answer: Give every agent standing only through a verifiable service history: the agent must finish useful jobs for established peers, each logged on-chain and countersigned by the peer. Fresh clones would each need hours of real service from distinct established agents, and that cost is the point - a farm cannot fake dozens of genuine working relationships, no matter how loud its signal. Honest agents earn a harbor of trust one job at a time, and the reef of past work is what holds them in place.
